headline: Sensex and Nifty Eye Record Highs Amid Tata Steel Deal and Strong FII Buying

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Tata Steel announced a massive ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes for two units
Record FII buying has pushed Indian markets to 9-month highs during a four-week rally
Banking and IT stocks provided significant support for market recovery and record highs
India is showing resilience by decoupling from global routs caused by AI selloffs
whatHappening: NIFTY50 reached 25,801 while the NIFTY Bank index hit a record high
SpiceJet faces a deepening crisis as the Federation of Indian Pilots writes to the Civil Aviation Minister
Food regulator FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri over unsafe water samples
Global sentiment remains mixed due to US Fed signals regarding potential future rate hikes
summary: Indian markets reached 9-month highs following a four-week rally driven by record FII buying and strong performance in banking and IT sectors. Tata Steel made headlines with a major ₹28,000 crore deal, while SpiceJet continues to face operational challenges. Despite global volatility from AI selloffs and Fed signals, the domestic market remains resilient near all-time highs.
